definitions.explanation: A primate with a long tail.

examples.english: A monkey fell from the tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{猿|さる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧{猿|さる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Photos of monkeys bathing in hot springs are famous.

notes:
{猿|さる} is the general word for monkey or ape. In Japanese, the same word covers both monkeys and apes, unlike English which distinguishes them. Japan's native species is the ⟦{日本猿|にほんざる}→日本猿：27875_nihonzaru⟧ (Japanese macaque), found throughout the country.

ZODIAC:
⟦{申|さる}→申：noentry⟧ is the ninth animal of the Chinese zodiac (⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧). Written with a different kanji from the animal.

- {猿|さる}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: even experts make mistakes (lit. even monkeys fall from trees)
- ⟦{犬猿|けんえん}→犬猿：28003_kenen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧: bitter enemies (lit. dog-monkey relationship)
- ⟦{猿真似|さるまね}→猿真似：27830_sarumane⟧: blind imitation, copycat behavior

CULTURE:
The ⟦{三猿|さんざる}→三猿：28476_sanzaru⟧ (three wise monkeys — see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil) at ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧⟦{東照宮|とうしょうぐう}→東照宮：28793_toushouguu⟧ are one of Japan's most famous carvings.
